shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; ls -R /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui; echo ----; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v node_modules

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ----; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -A6 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120; echo ----; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 'ThemeProvider' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -120; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch Button 2>&1 | head -60

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---- README; grep -n -i -B2 -A14 'ThemeProvider\|useTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; echo ---- DTS; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts 2>&1; echo ---- SEG; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>&1 | head -80; echo ---- SWITCH; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>&1 | head -80

grep -n -A12 'interface ControlGroupProps\|interface ControlProps\|interface ControlGroupOption' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo ---- TEXT; grep -n 'TEXT_VARIANTS\|variant' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -20; echo ---- EXPORTS; grep -n "Flex\|Card\|Text'\|Label\|SegmentedRadioGroup\|Switch" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head; echo ---- EVAL; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; cat AGENTS.md

grep -n "ContainerCardView\|TEXT_COLORS" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -4; echo ---- TSC; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo ---- BUILD; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8
cat .gitignore; rm -rf dist; git status --short | grep dist || echo "dist removed"
